Humility

blocks.text: Humility is the opposite of Ego. Ego is the false idea that we are separate from, or better than, others. It is the “I, Me, and Mine” voice in our head that constantly seeks to possess and gain attention, credit, and control. Humility arises out of the consciousness that is grateful.

blocks.html: Kindness

blocks.text: Kindness is the opposite of self-centeredness. Kindness is rooted in humility and arises from the deep understanding of truth that all life is interconnected, calling us to treat every being with care & compassion.

Love

blocks.text: A Recap of the HKL Journey
blocks.html:
A Recap of the
HKL Journey

blocks.text: Since the launch of the HKL Global Movement in Amritsar, India on November 13, 2024, seven additional transformative conferences have taken place in Parma, Italy; Vancouver, Canada; Bulandpuri, Punjab; Sydney; Australia, Telford; UK and Toronto; Canada. Together, these gatherings have drawn more than 23,000 attendees in person and over half a million participants online. What began as a vision has now reached 116 countries and territories and continues to accelerate with remarkable momentum.

Punjab, India (November 13, 2024)

blocks.text: The message was clear: these virtues are essential for humanity to recognize its true self and live in harmony and joy. Speakers reflected on how ego and fear have distanced us from our natural state of compassion, and how returning to these virtues can restore harmony within ourselves and across society. This gathering initiated a transformational shift, inviting all to embrace Humility, Kindness, and Love in their hearts.

blocks.text: The movement carried forward to Parma, Italy, where Mayor Michele Guerra acknowledged the conference's profound relevance. blocks.text: Nearly 3,000 people gathered at the Mississauga Sports and Entertainment Centre on August 8 for the 7th International Conference of the Humility, Kindness & Love Global Movement. blocks.text: Since the launch of the HKL Global Movement in Amritsar, India on November 13, 2024, seven additional transformative conferences have taken place in Parma, Italy; Vancouver, Canada; Bulandpuri, Punjab; Sydney; Australia, Telford; UK and Toronto; Canada. Together, these gatherings have drawn more than 23,000 attendees in person and over half a million participants online. What began as a vision has now reached 116 countries and territories and continues to accelerate with remarkable momentum.

pages.title: About Baptiste Antoine | HKL Board of Directors

pages.description: Meet Baptiste Antoine, HKL Board Member. Read about his professional background in psychology, psychotherapy, systemic therapy, and community education.

blocks.html: Mr. Baptiste Antoine
Luxembourg

blocks.text: Born in Belgium in the early 1980s, Baptiste is the eldest of five children in a family of teachers. From a young age, he navigated emotional challenges and exhibited a deep sensitivity, curiosity, and strong sense of responsibility—qualities that would shape both his struggles and his strengths. He initially pursued a childhood dream by studying and briefly working in the field of aviation, before turning toward psychology and psychotherapy. Over time, he also took on the roles of educator and supervisor, teaching educational professionals and guiding psychotherapists in their practice.

pages.heading: 4th HKL Global Conference
pages.description: Join the 4th HKL Global Conference in Punjab, India and explore the transformative message of Humility, Kindness & Love (HKL) with a growing international community.

blocks.html: One Year of HKL

blocks.text: Marking the one-year anniversary of the Global Movement, the 4th International Conference of HKL Movement returned to Punjab, India. This three-day event featured profound spiritual teachings, music, and collective meditation.
blocks.html:
Marking the one-year anniversary of the Global Movement, the 4th International Conference of HKL  Movement returned to Punjab, India.

This three-day event featured profound spiritual teachings, music, and collective meditation.

blocks.alt: HKL- Coming home to our true selves

blocks.text: This conference was more than a meeting; it was a
blocks.html: This conference was more than a meeting; it was a
"Coming Home to our True Selves"
The Opening Ceremony

blocks.text: As the ceremony began, HKL volunteers walked in with the flags of 45 countries, each flag telling the story of the movement’s growing presence around the globe.
blocks.html: As the ceremony began, HKL volunteers walked in with the flags of 45 countries, each flag telling the story of the movement’s growing presence around the globe.

blocks.text: The torch ceremony to start the conference is deeply symbolic. It represents the Divine Light that exists within each of us. This light is a reminder that humility, kindness and love are not qualities we need to search for outside ourselves. They already live within us and are simply waiting to be awakened. When the torch is lit it marks a collective moment of remembrance. A remembering of who we truly are.ing about the torch here

The Conference

blocks.text: Baba Ji, delivered a hard-hitting message about our current state of existence. He observed that most of us are "living in sleep in ego a reactive behavior," governed by outside information rather than inner truth. He urged us to realize that HKL is not a behavior we learn, but our "God-given virtues" that we must wake up to.

pages.heading: 2nd International Wave of HKL- Parma, Italy
pages.description: Be part of the 2nd HKL Conference in Parma, Italy on April 5 2025. Discover the power of humility, kindness & love (HKL) in this life-changing gathering of hearts.

blocks.text: 2nd International Wave of HKL- Parma, Italy
blocks.html: 2nd International Wave of HKL- Parma, Italy
April 5, 2025

blocks.text: Over 3,500 attendees from 32 countries participated in person, joined by 113,000 online viewers from 85 countries
blocks.html: Over 3,500 attendees from 32 countries participated in person, joined by 113,000 online viewers from 85 countries
Be the Beauty Within

blocks.text: The Wave of Humility, Kindness & Love arrived in Parma, Italy on April 5th. At this transformative event, spiritual leaders and scholars from diverse traditions came together to share their wisdom on how to Come Home To Our True Self And Be The Beauty Within!
blocks.html: The $Wave of Humility, Kindness & Love/$ arrived in Parma, Italy on April 5th. At this transformative event, spiritual leaders and scholars from diverse traditions came together to share their wisdom on how to Come Home To Our True Self And Be The Beauty Within!

blocks.text: Over 3,500 participants gathered in person from 32 countries, with 113,000+ joining live from 85 countries around the world . If you missed the live-stream, click here to watch it!
blocks.html: Over 3,500 participants gathered in person from 32 countries, with 113,000+ joining live from 85 countries around the world. If you missed the live-stream, click $here/$ to watch it!
Watch the Recorded Session

blocks.text: A transformational shift was set into motion.
blocks.html: A transformational shift was set into motion.

blocks.text: In the days leading up to the Italy conference, attendees from around the globe walked the streets of Parma to personally invite the local community to the event and to share the message of Love and Unity. Flowers were offered along with handwritten notes— gentle reminders that we are all flowers of the same garden, each one unique, yet housing the same fragrance of humility, kindness, and love.
blocks.html: In the days leading up to the Italy conference, attendees from around the globe walked the streets of Parma to personally invite the local community to the event and to share the message of Love and Unity. Flowers were offered along with handwritten notes— gentle reminders that we are all flowers of the same garden, each one unique, yet housing the same fragrance of humility, kindness, and love.

blocks.text: The response was beautiful. Those who received the gifts welcomed them with open hearts, and their faces blossomed with joy. Their feedback was filled with warmth, encouragement, and hope — showing that simple and small gestures of love can awaken the shared humanity within us all.
blocks.html: The response was beautiful. Those who received the gifts welcomed them with open hearts, and their faces blossomed with joy. Their feedback was filled with warmth, encouragement, and hope — showing that simple and small gestures of love can awaken the shared humanity within us all.
Conference Highlights

blocks.text: Messages of Love and Positivity Upon arrival, each attendee received a note filled with uplifting messages of love, humility, and kindness — simple reminders to awaken the light we all carry within. A few examples: “May you and all of humanity recover inner peace, welcome positive energy, and cultivate loving thoughts.” ~ " Kindness shouldn’t be earned. It should be freely given, because regardless of religion, nationality, or background, every soul longs for peace, love, and understanding.” ~ “There is no such thing as a small act of kindness. When you are kind to others, it changes the world”.
blocks.html: Messages of Love and PositivityUpon arrival, each attendee received a note filled with uplifting messages of love, humility, and kindness — simple reminders to awaken the light we all carry within.A few examples: “May you and all of humanity recover inner peace, welcome positive energy, and cultivate loving thoughts.” ~"Kindness shouldn’t be earned. It should be freely given, because regardless of religion, nationality, or background, every soul longs for peace, love, and understanding.” ~ “There is no such thing as a small act of kindness. When you are kind to others, it changes the world”.

blocks.text: Meditation Many presenters guided participants inward, inviting them into meditation. Through meditation we were collectively able to experience the divine peace that is within each human heart. Participants experienced firsthand how meditation can serve as a powerful path—one that helps uncover the hidden treasures of love, humility, kindness, and compassion, waiting to be awakened and shared with the world.
blocks.html:
MeditationMany presenters guided participants inward, inviting them into meditation. Through meditation we were collectively able to experience the divine peace that is within each human heart.
Participants experienced firsthand how meditation can serve as a powerful path—one that helps uncover the hidden treasures of love, humility, kindness, and compassion, waiting to be awakened and shared with the world.

blocks.text: Reflection Wall Attendees were invited to reflect and respond to two meaningful questions: “What does humility mean to you?” and “Do you put others before yourself, and how do you feel when you do?” The wall soon blossomed with heartfelt, thoughtful answers that revealed the deep sincerity and shared longing for a more compassionate world.

blocks.text: Music Throughout the day, performances by I Musici Di Parma Orchestra and Classical Indian Musicians uplifted the atmosphere, while videos were shown, displaying how the power of practical actions of kindness, love, and humility dissolve barriers of the heart and give birth to unity and joy.

pages.title: Launch of the Humility, Kindness & Love (HKL) Movement | Punjab, India
pages.heading: Launch of the Wave of HKL- Punjab, India
pages.description: The Humility, Kindness & Love (HKL) global movement was launched on November 13, 2024, at Sri Harmandir Sahib, Amritsar Sahib, Punjab India.  Relive the powerful moments and experience the transformative spirit of HKL.

blocks.text: Launch of the Wave of HKL- Punjab, India
blocks.html: Launch of the Wave of HKL- Punjab, India
November 13, 2024

blocks.text: More than 10,000 people from 39 countries gathered in person, while thousands more watched online from across the globe
blocks.html: More than 10,000 people from 39 countries gathered in person, while thousands more watched online from across the globe

blocks.alt: Launch of the wave of HKL in Punjab

blocks.text: A transformational shift was set into motion.
blocks.html: A transformational shift was set into motion.

blocks.text: With the vision of a brighter future for all humanity, a Global Wave of Humility, Kindness & Love was launched on 13 November 2024 from the sacred grounds of Sri Harmandir Sahib in Amritsar, Punjab, India .
blocks.html: With the vision of a brighter future for all humanity, a Global Wave of Humility, Kindness & Love was launched on 13 November 2024 from the sacred grounds of Sri Harmandir Sahib in Amritsar, Punjab, India.

blocks.text: The launch of this wave brought together an extraordinary gathering. Leaders of all major world religions, spiritual devotees radiating divinity, revered saints, vice-chancellors of esteemed universities, intellectuals, writers, philosophers, and countless souls dedicated to the welfare of humanity united in a shared purpose.
blocks.html: The launch of this wave brought together an extraordinary gathering. Leaders of all major world religions, spiritual devotees radiating divinity, revered saints, vice-chancellors of esteemed universities, intellectuals, writers, philosophers, and countless souls dedicated to the welfare of humanity united in a shared purpose.

blocks.text: A transformational shift unfolded, inviting each of us to embrace Humility, Kindness & Love in our hearts. This global movement, aimed at awakening HKL in all, serves as a healing response to the deep fragmentation within humanity today.
blocks.html: A transformational shift unfolded, inviting each of us to embrace Humility, Kindness & Love in our hearts. This global movement, aimed at awakening HKL in all, serves as a healing response to the deep fragmentation within humanity today.

blocks.text: This powerful force of HKL echoed far beyond the gathering and touched hearts across the globe. It called each of us to go within—to reconnect with the essence of who we truly are and to awaken the timeless virtues of Humility, Kindness & Love that already live within our hearts.
blocks.html: This powerful force of HKL echoed far beyond the gathering and touched hearts across the globe. It called each of us to go within—to reconnect with the essence of who we truly are and to awaken the timeless virtues of Humility, Kindness & Love that already live within our hearts.

Man, and his humanity is his character. We should always remain human and maintain our humanity.

To nurture that connection, and connect to this Divine love within us that dispels all differences, we must engage in simran, in meditation.

About this event
Returning to Bulandpuri Sahib

blocks.text: The Humility, Kindness & Love Global Movement began in Amritsar on 13 November 2024. Since then, conferences in Parma, Vancouver, Bulandpuri, Sydney, Telford and Toronto have drawn more than 23,000 people in person and over half a million online. The 8th International Conference returns to Bulandpuri Sahib in Punjab for three days, 15 to 17 November 2026, two years after the movement began. Everyone is welcome, and entry is free. Each day runs from 10 AM to 5 PM at The University, Bulandpuri Sahib, Jalandhar, Punjab.

blocks.text: Beg the Divine for His Grace
blocks.html: Beg the Divine for His Grace

blocks.text: We can feel that we are not peaceful. We are not peaceful because we are not feeling fulfilled. Every day we want more… higher position at work, more recognition, more youthfulness, more wealth, more power. Wanting more and more every day makes us unpeaceful.
blocks.html: We can feel that we are not peaceful. We are not peaceful because we are not feeling fulfilled. Every day we want more… higher position at work, more recognition, more youthfulness, more wealth, more power. Wanting more and more every day makes us unpeaceful.

blocks.text: And the moment we recognize ourselves, instantly we become peaceful and recognize that I am fully fulfilled. We won't find absolutely any thirst in us for anything. This is the beauty of human life. This is how beautiful our creator has created us, that our true self is so peaceful, so fulfilled.

blocks.text: We are on the journey of recognizing our true self. Daily HKL practices are transforming us, but there are few things to know and remain alert about.
blocks.html: We are on the journey of recognizing our true self. Daily HKL practices are transforming us, but there are few things to know and remain alert about.

blocks.text: As we start transforming, that transformation will not become visible to our eyes or to our ears, but that transformation in us is going to be felt within. And as soon as the transformation starts happening, we would become scared, and we would quit going further and come back to our old miserable way of life.

blocks.text: The reason is that as we do these practices, the outside world is not going to change. Same roads, same house, same people in the house, same skies, everything same. But what will change is the way we look at others, the way we listen to others, and the way we interact with others, and that scares us and others too.

blocks.text: Because up until yesterday, we were so anxious to have somebody in our lives. And today, when we look at them, we don't find any new flowers blooming within us. Why? Because as we start moving towards ourselves, we start feeling fulfilled and already peaceful. The things about which we remain worried day and night, those worries start losing their grip on us. Our appreciation, which used to bring smiles to our faces, does nothing to our inside. And something which we felt insulted and were carrying with us for months, we become so stunned that how come this happened to me?

blocks.text: All these things do not happen for nothing. They are the signs of our changing insides. They are the signs of the changing of our inner atmospheres. That is the time when the blessed life starts entering into our home. And we become scared. The question arises: why? And this must be understood, and we must remain alert to, please. The reason is that we want a new life, but we don't want to leave anything from the old life.

Humility

blocks.text: Humility is the opposite of Ego. Ego is the false idea that we are separate from, or better than, others. It is the “I, Me, and Mine” voice in our head that constantly seeks to possess and gain attention, credit, and control. Humility arises out of the consciousness that is grateful.

blocks.html: This week, our practice is to remember throughout the entire day that I want to establish a loving and everlasting relationship with the Divine.

blocks.text: Day and night, remember Him. Lovingly speak to the Divine within, and we would feel utterly humble, down to earth, grateful, and loving.

blocks.text: If I have established a loving, everlasting relationship with the Divine, then not only is He mine now, but the whole world is mine. Wherever I look, everything, everybody seems mine. blocks.text: We together are making ourselves truly beautiful every day by practicing the daily commitments . This week, let us commit to ourselves that I'm going to remind myself many times during the day that my body always lives in the present . My consciousness might be moving between future and past, but my body is always in the present.

blocks.text: So many times during the day, we come and see where our body is. In this way, we immediately come into the present. In every human being's heart, the Divine light is radiating from, and our core, innate virtues are humility, kindness & love. So, many times during the day, we come to where our body is, in the present. With closed eyes, we feel our insides and feel as if our insides are saying to us, " Welcome to the home of humility, kindness & love ." In this way, we recognize that we are here in the home of humility, kindness & love.

blocks.text: We humans are on our individual journeys, journeys of life. The journey is to know our true selves. Once we recognize ourselves, then all the doors open to infinite beauties. In order to recognize who we are, first we have to become peaceful.
blocks.html: We humans are on our individual journeys, journeys of life. The journey is to know our true selves.  Once we recognize ourselves, then all the doors open to infinite beauties. In order to recognize who we are, first we have to become peaceful.

blocks.text: So let us sit, please, with closed eyes, settle down. And with closed eyes, feel that on both sides of our heads, there are ears. Let us bring our conscienceness, our focus on one or both ears. While staying there, we are going to remind ourselves that our true being is utterly peaceful. We are a presence of peacefulness.
blocks.html: So let us sit, please, with closed eyes, settle down. And with closed eyes, feel that on both sides of our heads, there are ears. Let us bring our conscienceness, our focus on one or both ears. While staying there, we are going to remind ourselves that our true being is utterly peaceful. We are a presence of peacefulness.

blocks.text: So with closed eyes, staying at our ears, we are going to utter, I am peacefulness. And it is very important that we listen to our own utterances. Listening to our own voice is going to take us to our true being. That's where the voice is coming from.
blocks.html: So with closed eyes, staying at our ears, we are going to utter, I am peacefulness. And it is very important that we listen to our own utterances. Listening to our own voice is going to take us to our true being. That's where the voice is coming from.

blocks.text: That total peacefulness is nothing but love. And love is not just an emotion or feeling. It's much more than that. We would experience that ourselves. So we are going to recite and listen to our own sound. Lovingly, please utter, I am peacefulness.
blocks.html: That total peacefulness is nothing but love. And love is not just an emotion or feeling. It's much more than that. We would experience that ourselves. So we are going to recite and listen to our own sound. Lovingly, please utter, I am peacefulness.

blocks.text: The longer we sit, we would start feeling totally peaceful. When we feel peaceful within, we feel peaceful with ourselves. And then when we open our eyes gently, slowly, then we would feel that I'm peaceful with everything. And we would feel that there might be noise outside, but that noise is just on the surface. Behind that noise is deep peace, which is pure love.
